# Quizmon

> Take the five-question Pokémon Daily Challenge each day, then practice types, moves, evolutions, stats, and more.

Quizmon is a free, unofficial browser game. It has no accounts or application backend, and player settings and results remain on the device.

## Game

- [Quizmon overview](https://quizmon.raveh.dev/index.md): Game modes, question coverage, data use, offline behavior, and attribution.
- [Play Quizmon](https://quizmon.raveh.dev/): The interactive game.

## Project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/itay-raveh/quizmon): Source code, setup instructions, and license.
- [PokéAPI](https://pokeapi.co/): Source of Pokémon data and sprite artwork.
